name: Product Line Classification, SLA, Reporting

LLD-03 Service Request identity/lifecycle/current Customer context and accepted source projection readers
LLD-04 accepted source-observation provenance for Report Date/status/severity/suspension evidence
scope: Contract Product Line identity and lifecycle
immutable SLA policy revisions and exact cohort tiers
IT/NFV default policy templates and derived Non-fault inquiry tiers
deterministic reviewed SR classification and mapping rules
live cohort state and exact percentage arithmetic
immutable completed report evidence after verified XLSX artifact generation
closed cross-domain report section contribution contract
report staging/failure cleanup and minimum historical snapshot evidence
not_owned_here: Service Request source facts/lifecycle/Customer authority -> LLD-03/LLD-04
Inventory/Infrastructure/Communication/Overview report-section source facts -> their owning LLDs through read-only ReportSectionContributor
authentication/action proof and release dependency pinning -> LLD-12
transaction_boundaries: Policy input parsing, rational-duration/percentage validation, classification previews, live SLA/cohort calculations and report request/section preview work occur outside BEGIN IMMEDIATE using stable read abstractions.

Every Product Line, Contract, Contract Product Line, policy, mapping and classification authority mutation uses one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork, revalidates current Customer/CPL/policy/classification state and inserts one command receipt before receipt-FK children.
A policy revision, its immutable tiers and the Contract Product Line current-policy pointer advance atomically; prior revisions remain untouched.

A classification assignment/reclassification/invalidation event and its current-classification projection mutate atomically. SR Customer correction invokes LLD-06 only as a bounded same-UoW participant so incompatible classification invalidation cannot half-commit.

Live individual SLA and cohort results are pure reproducible reads for one explicit as_of_utc; projection recomputation writes no lifecycle/audit evidence and current-clock progression is not persisted as authority.

One report uses one stable LLD-01 read Snapshot with fixed as_of/timezone/scope. SLA calculations and every registered read-only ReportSectionContributor consume that same Snapshot, while a separate writer persists bounded non-authoritative staging batches without changing the read view.
Report snapshot sealing atomically revalidates exact persisted member/cohort/section counts, canonical order and snapshot SHA-256 before marking the attempt ready to generate.
XLSX generation and reopen/shape/count/hash verification occur outside authoritative writer transactions using sealed staging only; live domain tables are never queried by the artifact writer.
The verified report attempt, artifact hash/size/verification metadata and completion audit commit atomically. That transition makes staged snapshot children immutable CompletedReportEvidence.

Failed/cancelled report handling atomically removes only non-authoritative attempt-owned staging rows and records bounded terminal attempt metadata; completed evidence and operational domain records are never cleanup targets.
failure_modes: unresolved SR Customer, cross-customer CPL, inactive/policyless CPL, missing trusted mapping or multiple applicable mappings remain explicit unclassified/incompatible/ambiguous outcomes and never receive fabricated classification
classification commits fail closed on stale SR Customer/source input, CPL lifecycle/current policy, mapping set or current classification state

invalid, non-finite, excessive-precision or overflow-prone percentages/durations and exact 3/2 Non-fault derivations are rejected before authority mutation; no binary-floating or rounded fallback is permitted
missing Report Date, unresolved severity and Cancelled cohort exclusion are truthful projection states rather than synthetic timestamps/default severity or transport failure
SLA input or cross-domain dependency that is INDETERMINATE blocks authoritative classification/lifecycle mutation instead of guessing
stable read snapshots prevent policy/source/customer changes during SLA/cohort/report calculation from producing mixed-version results; later reads observe the later accepted state

report section failure, interrupted staging, persisted count/hash mismatch, partial artifact write, reopen/shape/count/hash verification failure or unsafe cancellation prevents completed-report publication
crash between artifact verification and completed transition is safely retryable against the exact sealed snapshot/artifact identity; audit failure rolls the completed transition back
failed/cancelled attempts cannot retain completed-looking full staged population, while temporary-file cleanup failure remains diagnostics only
completed report evidence rejects ordinary update/delete/cancel/minimize/cleanup, and external artifact movement/deletion does not rewrite immutable database evidence
deterministic rollback/race/error behavior is explicitly exercised by tests/failure-injection.json
review_evidence: Reusable Product Line identity, Customer-owned Contract and Contract Product Line SLA authority remain normalized as separate records and Customer compatibility is revalidated at classification time.
Immutable policy revisions use exact integer percentage representation and reduced rational-second thresholds; Non-fault inquiry tiers derive from Minor by exact 3/2 without floating-point rounding.
Trusted Customer Account Code mappings preserve ambiguity rather than imposing a uniqueness rule that would hide conflicting configuration.

Classification preview and batch preview are pure read models; accepted per-target classification remains independently auditable and batch application is intentionally not one giant writer transaction.
SR classification current/history are separate; Customer correction can invalidate an incompatible classification in the same caller UnitOfWork without guessing a replacement.
Current policy revisions apply to all currently classified applicable SRs on subsequent reads without rewriting SR rows or prior policy history.
Individual SLA uses accepted Report Date, first accepted effective Resolved/Closed endpoint, accepted cumulative source-reported suspension and exact inclusive tier comparison with zero clamp.
Canonical monthly cohort identity and period boundaries are fixed to America/Guayaquil; Objective scheduling timezone has no SLA/cohort/report-period authority.
Report construction uses one stable accepted-state Snapshot, closed/versioned read-only section contributors, minimized normalized staging and canonical snapshot hashing.
SLA_REPORT_XLSX_V1 writes only from sealed snapshot rows through a sibling temporary artifact, verifies reopen/shape/count/hash, rejects unrelated destination collisions and finalizes atomically.

CompletedReportEvidence is published only after successful artifact verification and exact completed transition; failed/cancelled staging is disposable technical data and never authorizes operational cleanup.
Migration sequence 6 and implementation module ownership are explicit; public routes use exact query/command owner names and internal report-worker transitions remain non-public.
Machine-readable traceability closes all six governing requirements plus command/query/test/index/audit/migration/cross-packet edges without changing product semantics.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 are both PASS; Pass 2 additionally closed report replay, durable-job recovery, artifact-candidate identity, cancellation races and transport/reference determinism.
design_principle: Reusable Product Line identity never carries global SLA authority. Current SLA truth is a reproducible projection over the SR's resolved Customer-compatible Contract Product Line, its current immutable policy revision and accepted source chronology; completed report evidence freezes only the minimum represented state after artifact verification and never becomes operational cleanup authority.
